# authwise_tenant_config (Data Source)

A tenant's config: its brand, and the token lifetimes and CORS at the tenant, the outermost layer. Builds the TenantConfig message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_tenant_config.config` takes. Makes no API calls.

When a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, Terraform reads this data source at apply rather than at plan, even though every argument is known: `json` shows as (known after apply), and `authwise_tenant_config.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op when nothing else changed. The function `provider::authwise::tenant_config` takes the same arguments as an object, returns the same string, and is evaluated at plan: use it to keep those plans quiet (Terraform 1.8 or later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant is the outermost layer of the token lifetimes: an issuer,
# audience or client that sets its own overrides it.
data "authwise_tenant_config" "this" {
  access_token_expire_seconds  = 900
  refresh_token_expire_seconds = 1209600

  branding = {
    logo_asset_id      = authwise_asset_content.logo.asset_id
    logo_dark_asset_id = authwise_asset_content.logo_dark.asset_id
  }

  cors = {
    allowed_origins = ["https://admin.example.com"]
  }
}

resource "authwise_tenant_config" "this" {
  config = data.authwise_tenant_config.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds. Unset takes the value from the layer above (tenant, issuer, audience, client).
- `branding` (Attributes) The tenant's own brand: what the admin console shows in place of the Authwise emblem, and what outbound mail falls back to when an appearance profile has no `main_logo`. **Deprecated:** set it with `authwise_tenant_branding` and leave it out here; kit refuses it here from the release train after 2026.11.3. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding))
- `cors` (Attributes) The browser origins allowed to call kit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors))
- `interaction_forward_uri` (String)
- `refresh_token_absolute_expire_seconds` (Number) Hard cap on a refresh token family in seconds, set once when the family is created. Unset takes the value from the layer above.
- `refresh_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Refresh token idle lifetime in seconds: it slides forward on every rotation. Unset takes the value from the layer above.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of TenantConfig, for `authwise_tenant_config.config`.

<a id="nestedatt--branding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding`

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) The brand's name, which mail shows and sends from (the From name). At most 64 characters on one line, none of `<`, `>` or `"`.
- `logo_asset_id` (String) The id (`as-…`) of an image asset in this tenant, e.g. `authwise_asset_content.logo.asset_id`. kit refuses an id that names no image asset of the tenant, and refuses deleting or emptying the asset while this names it.
- `logo_dark_asset_id` (String) The same, for a dark colour scheme. Optional: a reader falls back to `logo_asset_id`. kit refuses it without `logo_asset_id`.
- `theme_id` (String) The tenant's look: a theme of the tenant (`th-…`), from which mail takes its logo and colour. kit refuses deleting the theme while this names it.


<a id="nestedatt--cors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors`

Optional:

- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Origins allowed to call kit from a browser.
- `allowed_origins_regexp` (List of String) Origin patterns allowed to call kit from a browser.
